## Purpose

This page repeats in Python, for non-accidental mortality, the three analyses
added after the main models: the attributable burden
([R page](deliverable_3_models.html#sec-burden)), the adjusted models
([R page](deliverable_4_sensitivity.html#sec-sensitivity)) and the models with all the lags
([R page](deliverable_4_sensitivity.html#sec-lag-structure)). Nothing is read from the R results except
to compare at the end of each section.

Three pieces are written here independently of the R code:

- the conditional logistic regression, maximised by Newton-Raphson from its
  likelihood, as on the [Python models page](py_02_models.html);
- the natural cubic spline of temperature, built from the truncated power
  basis instead of the B-spline basis that R uses. The two bases span the same
  curves, so the odds ratios must coincide although the coefficients differ;
- the distributed-lag model of temperature, built from one spline per lag
  instead of the cross-basis of the `dlnm` package.

```{python}
#| label: setup
import hashlib
from pathlib import Path

import numpy as np
import pandas as pd
import yaml
from scipy import stats

ROOT = next(p for p in [Path.cwd(), *Path.cwd().parents] if (p / "_quarto.yml").exists())
DERIVED = ROOT / "Data" / "Derived"
TABLES = ROOT / "Output" / "Tables"


def merge_config(base, override):
    """Entries of `override` replace those of `base`, level by level."""
    out = dict(base)
    for key, value in override.items():
        if isinstance(value, dict) and isinstance(out.get(key), dict):
            out[key] = merge_config(out[key], value)
        else:
            out[key] = value
    return out


CFG = yaml.safe_load((ROOT / "config" / "config.yml").read_text(encoding="utf-8"))
LOCAL = ROOT / "config" / "local.yml"
if LOCAL.exists():
    CFG = merge_config(CFG, yaml.safe_load(LOCAL.read_text(encoding="utf-8")))


def get_param(*keys):
    """Read one parameter; stop when it is missing or still null."""
    value = CFG
    for key in keys:
        if not isinstance(value, dict) or value.get(key) is None:
            raise KeyError(f"Parameter {'$'.join(keys)} is not set in config/config.yml")
        value = value[key]
    return value


MANIFEST = pd.read_csv(ROOT / "Data" / "input_manifest.csv", dtype=str)
VERIFIED = set()


def verify_input(name, path):
    """Stop unless the input is, byte for byte, the file listed in Data/input_manifest.csv."""
    if name in VERIFIED:
        return
    expected = MANIFEST[MANIFEST["input"] == name]
    if expected.empty:
        raise KeyError(f"Input '{name}' is not listed in Data/input_manifest.csv")
    for row in expected.itertuples():
        file = path / row.file if path.is_dir() else path
        if not file.exists():
            raise FileNotFoundError(f"Input '{name}': file not found: {file}")
        digest = hashlib.md5(usedforsecurity=False)
        with open(file, "rb") as handle:
            for block in iter(lambda: handle.read(1 << 20), b""):
                digest.update(block)
        if file.stat().st_size != int(row.bytes) or digest.hexdigest() != row.md5:
            raise ValueError(f"Input '{name}' is not the file the results were produced from: {file}")
    VERIFIED.add(name)


def input_path(name):
    root = Path(get_param("paths", "input_root")).expanduser()
    if not root.is_absolute():
        root = ROOT / root
    path = Path(get_param("inputs", name)).expanduser()
    if not path.is_absolute():
        path = root / path
    if not path.exists():
        raise FileNotFoundError(f"Input '{name}' not found: {path}")
    verify_input(name, path)
    return path


municipalities = pd.read_csv(ROOT / get_param("study", "municipalities_file"))
STUDY_YEARS = get_param("mortality", "years")
WARM_MONTHS = get_param("study", "warm_season_months")
LAGS = get_param("design", "lags_days")
LAG_MAIN = get_param("models", "lag_main")
CONF = get_param("models", "conf_level")
Z = stats.norm.ppf(1 - (1 - CONF) / 2)
AGE_LABELS = get_param("mortality", "age_labels")
CATEGORIES = ["e10", "e01", "e11"]
HEATWAVE = get_param("models", "heatwave_main")
OZONE_SERIES = (f"{get_param('air_pollution', 'ozone_series_main')}_"
                f"{get_param('air_pollution', 'interpolation_method_main')}")
OZONE_FLAG = f"{OZONE_SERIES}_gt_p{get_param('models', 'ozone_cutoff_main')}"
LOW_FLAG = f"{OZONE_SERIES}_gt_p{get_param('sensitivity', 'low_ozone_cutoff')}"
METHOD = get_param("air_pollution", "interpolation_method_main")
INCREMENTS = get_param("sensitivity", "adjustment_increments")
TEMPERATURE = get_param("temperature_response")
OZONE_INCREMENT = get_param("distributed_lags", "ozone_increment_ppb")
assert TEMPERATURE["scale"] == "local_percentile"


def relative_difference(python_values, r_values):
    """Largest difference by row, relative to the R value when it exceeds one."""
    python_values, r_values = np.asarray(python_values, float), np.asarray(r_values, float)
    return (np.abs(python_values - r_values) / np.maximum(1, np.abs(r_values))).max(axis=1)


worst = {}
```

## Deaths, referent days and exposures

The same steps as on the [Python models page](py_02_models.html).

```{python}
#| label: deaths
needed = ["FECHA_DEF", "SEXO_NOMBRE", "EDAD_TIPO", "EDAD_CANT", "COD_COMUNA", "DIAG1"]
deaths = pd.read_csv(input_path("deis_deaths"), sep=";", encoding="latin-1", usecols=needed,
                     parse_dates=["FECHA_DEF"]).dropna(subset=["FECHA_DEF", "COD_COMUNA"])
deaths = deaths[deaths["COD_COMUNA"].isin(municipalities["code"])
                & deaths["FECHA_DEF"].dt.year.between(*STUDY_YEARS)
                & deaths["FECHA_DEF"].dt.month.isin(WARM_MONTHS)].copy()


def icd_key(code3):
    """Numeric key of a three-character ICD-10 category: 'I21' -> 821."""
    return code3.str[0].map(lambda c: ord(c) - ord("A")) * 100 + code3.str[1:3].astype(int)


key = icd_key(deaths["DIAG1"].str[:3])
low, high = get_param("mortality", "cause_groups")["non_accidental"][0].split("-")
deaths = deaths[key.between(icd_key(pd.Series([low]))[0], icd_key(pd.Series([high]))[0])].copy()
age = deaths["EDAD_CANT"].where(deaths["EDAD_TIPO"] == 1, 0.0).where(deaths["EDAD_TIPO"].isin([1, 2, 3, 4]))
deaths["age_group"] = pd.cut(age, get_param("mortality", "age_breaks") + [np.inf],
                             labels=AGE_LABELS, right=False)
deaths = deaths.rename(columns={"FECHA_DEF": "date", "COD_COMUNA": "com"})[["com", "date", "age_group"]]
print(f"{len(deaths):,} non-accidental deaths")


def referent_table(selected):
    """One row per municipality, day of death and referent day (same year,
    month and day of the week), with the number of deaths as weight."""
    strata = (selected.groupby(["com", "date"]).size().rename("n_deaths").reset_index()
              .rename(columns={"date": "case_date"}))
    strata["stratum"] = np.arange(len(strata))
    calendar = pd.DataFrame({"date": pd.date_range(strata["case_date"].min() - pd.Timedelta(days=31),
                                                   strata["case_date"].max() + pd.Timedelta(days=31))})
    for frame, column in ((strata, "case_date"), (calendar, "date")):
        frame["yr"], frame["mo"], frame["wd"] = (frame[column].dt.year, frame[column].dt.month,
                                                 frame[column].dt.dayofweek)
    table = strata.merge(calendar, on=["yr", "mo", "wd"])
    table["case"] = (table["date"] == table["case_date"]).astype(int)
    return table.sort_values(["stratum", "date"]).reset_index(drop=True)


exposure = pd.read_csv(
    DERIVED / "py_exposure_2009_2020.csv", parse_dates=["date"],
    usecols=["com", "date", "year", "in_study_period", "warm_season", HEATWAVE, OZONE_FLAG, LOW_FLAG,
             OZONE_SERIES, TEMPERATURE["variable"], *[f"{v}_{METHOD}" for v in INCREMENTS]])


def with_lag(columns, lag, suffix=""):
    """Exposure `lag` days before each day, columns renamed with `suffix`."""
    out = exposure[["com", "date", *columns]].copy()
    out["date"] = out["date"] + pd.Timedelta(days=lag)
    return out.rename(columns={c: f"{c}{suffix}" for c in columns})


def complete_strata(data, columns):
    """Rows of the strata where every column is known on every referent day."""
    incomplete = data.loc[data[columns].isna().any(axis=1), "stratum"].unique()
    return data[~data["stratum"].isin(incomplete)].sort_values(["stratum", "date"])


def conditional_logit(x, data):
    """Weighted conditional logistic regression, one case per stratum.
    Maximises sum_s w_s [x_case'b - log sum_j exp(x_j'b)] by Newton-Raphson and
    returns the estimates and the inverse of the observed information."""
    x = np.asarray(x, dtype=float)
    case, stratum = data["case"].to_numpy(), data["stratum"].to_numpy()
    weight = data["n_deaths"].to_numpy(float)
    starts = np.flatnonzero(np.r_[True, stratum[1:] != stratum[:-1]])
    counts = np.diff(np.r_[starts, len(stratum)])
    w = weight[starts]
    x_case = x[case == 1]
    assert len(x_case) == len(starts)
    beta = np.zeros(x.shape[1])
    for _ in range(50):
        eta = x @ beta
        eta = eta - np.repeat(np.maximum.reduceat(eta, starts), counts)
        e = np.exp(eta)
        p = e / np.repeat(np.add.reduceat(e, starts), counts)
        mean_x = np.add.reduceat(p[:, None] * x, starts, axis=0)
        score = (w[:, None] * (x_case - mean_x)).sum(axis=0)
        # sum_s w_s [sum_j p_j x_j x_j' - m_s m_s']
        information = (x * (weight * p)[:, None]).T @ x - (mean_x * w[:, None]).T @ mean_x
        step = np.linalg.solve(information, score)
        beta = beta + step
        if np.max(np.abs(step)) < 1e-10:
            return beta, np.linalg.inv(information)
    raise RuntimeError("Newton-Raphson did not converge")


def odds_ratio_rows(names, beta, covariance):
    se = np.sqrt(np.diag(covariance))
    return pd.DataFrame({"term": names, "or": np.exp(beta), "or_low": np.exp(beta - Z * se),
                         "or_high": np.exp(beta + Z * se)})


def combination(weights, beta, covariance):
    """Odds ratio and interval of the linear combination weights'beta."""
    estimate = float(weights @ beta)
    se = float(np.sqrt(weights @ covariance @ weights))
    return np.exp(estimate), np.exp(estimate - Z * se), np.exp(estimate + Z * se)


def reoi(beta, covariance):
    """REOI = OR11 - OR10 - OR01 + 1 with its delta-method interval."""
    or10, or01, or11 = np.exp(beta)
    gradient = np.array([-or10, -or01, or11])
    estimate = or11 - or10 - or01 + 1
    se = float(np.sqrt(gradient @ covariance @ gradient))
    return estimate, estimate - Z * se, estimate + Z * se


def add_categories(data, hw="hw", oz="oz", suffix=""):
    data[f"e10{suffix}"] = ((data[hw] == 1) & (data[oz] == 0)).astype(float)
    data[f"e01{suffix}"] = ((data[hw] == 0) & (data[oz] == 1)).astype(float)
    data[f"e11{suffix}"] = ((data[hw] == 1) & (data[oz] == 1)).astype(float)
    return data
```

## Attributable burden

Odds ratios by age group at lag `{python} LAG_MAIN`, deaths per day on the days
with neither exposure by municipality, calendar year and age group, and the
excess $\text{baseline} \times (OR - 1) \times \text{exposed days}$, with the
delta-method interval.

```{python}
#| label: burden
flags = with_lag([HEATWAVE, OZONE_FLAG], LAG_MAIN).rename(columns={HEATWAVE: "hw", OZONE_FLAG: "oz"})
study_days = exposure.loc[exposure["in_study_period"] & exposure["warm_season"], ["com", "date", "year"]]
days = add_categories(study_days.merge(flags, on=["com", "date"], how="left", validate="1:1"))
days["category"] = np.select([days["e10"] == 1, days["e01"] == 1, days["e11"] == 1,
                              (days["hw"] == 0) & (days["oz"] == 0)], ["e10", "e01", "e11", "e00"],
                             default="unknown")
assert (days["category"] != "unknown").all()

models, cells = {}, []
for age_group in AGE_LABELS:
    selected = deaths[deaths["age_group"] == age_group]
    data = add_categories(complete_strata(
        referent_table(selected).merge(flags, on=["com", "date"], how="left", validate="m:1"), ["hw", "oz"]))
    models[age_group] = conditional_logit(data[CATEGORIES], data)
    per_day = selected.groupby(["com", "date"]).size().rename("n").reset_index()
    counted = days.merge(per_day, on=["com", "date"], how="left", validate="1:1").fillna({"n": 0})
    assert counted["n"].sum() == len(selected)
    table = (counted.groupby(["com", "year", "category"]).agg(days=("n", "size"), deaths=("n", "sum"))
             .reset_index())
    reference = (table[table["category"] == "e00"].set_index(["com", "year"])
                 .rename(columns={"days": "reference_days", "deaths": "reference_deaths"})
                 [["reference_days", "reference_deaths"]])
    exposed = table[table["category"] != "e00"].join(reference, on=["com", "year"])
    assert exposed["reference_days"].gt(0).all()
    exposed["expected"] = exposed["reference_deaths"] / exposed["reference_days"] * exposed["days"]
    cells.append(exposed.assign(age_group=age_group))
cells = pd.concat(cells, ignore_index=True)


def burden(group):
    """Excess deaths of a group of cells, by category and for the three together."""
    rows = []
    for target in [*CATEGORIES, "any"]:
        include = np.array([target in (c, "any") for c in CATEGORIES], float)
        excess = attributable = variance = variance_attributable = 0.0
        for age_group, (beta, covariance) in models.items():
            part = group[group["age_group"] == age_group].groupby("category")[["expected", "deaths"]].sum()
            expected = part["expected"].reindex(CATEGORIES, fill_value=0).to_numpy()
            observed = part["deaths"].reindex(CATEGORIES, fill_value=0).to_numpy()
            odds = np.exp(beta)
            excess += (include * expected * (odds - 1)).sum()
            attributable += (include * observed * (1 - 1 / odds)).sum()
            g = include * expected * odds
            variance += g @ covariance @ g
            g = include * observed / odds
            variance_attributable += g @ covariance @ g
        rows.append({"category": target, "excess": excess, "excess_low": excess - Z * np.sqrt(variance),
                     "excess_high": excess + Z * np.sqrt(variance), "attributable": attributable,
                     "attributable_low": attributable - Z * np.sqrt(variance_attributable),
                     "attributable_high": attributable + Z * np.sqrt(variance_attributable)})
    return pd.DataFrame(rows)


burden_python = pd.concat([
    burden(cells).assign(level="total", year=np.nan, com=np.nan),
    *[burden(g).assign(level="year", year=year, com=np.nan) for year, g in cells.groupby("year")],
    *[burden(g).assign(level="municipality", year=np.nan, com=com) for com, g in cells.groupby("com")],
], ignore_index=True)
```

```{python}
#| label: tbl-burden
#| tbl-cap: "Excess non-accidental deaths, warm seasons of the study years: Python against R."
value_columns = ["excess", "excess_low", "excess_high", "attributable", "attributable_low",
                 "attributable_high"]
burden_r = pd.read_csv(TABLES / "burden_estimates.csv")
burden_r = burden_r[(burden_r["outcome"] == "non_accidental") & (burden_r["lag"] == LAG_MAIN)
                    & (burden_r["or_source"] == "age-specific")
                    & burden_r["level"].isin(["total", "year", "municipality"])]
compared = burden_python.merge(burden_r[["level", "year", "com", "category", *value_columns]],
                               on=["level", "year", "com", "category"], suffixes=("_python", "_r"),
                               validate="1:1")
assert len(compared) == len(burden_python) == len(burden_r)
compared["difference"] = relative_difference(compared[[f"{c}_python" for c in value_columns]],
                                             compared[[f"{c}_r" for c in value_columns]])
worst["burden"] = compared["difference"].max()
shown = compared[compared["level"] == "total"]
(shown[["category", "excess_python", "excess_low_python", "excess_high_python", "excess_r",
        "attributable_python", "attributable_r", "difference"]]
 .style.format({c: "{:,.1f}" for c in ["excess_python", "excess_low_python", "excess_high_python",
                                        "excess_r", "attributable_python", "attributable_r"]}
               | {"difference": "{:.1e}"}).hide(axis="index"))
```

```{python}
      f"{compared['com'].nunique()} municipalities, four categories each)")
```

## Adjusted models

```{python}
#| label: temperature-scale
variable = TEMPERATURE["variable"]
warm = exposure[exposure["in_study_period"] & exposure["warm_season"]]
reference_values = {com: np.sort(g[variable].to_numpy()) for com, g in warm.groupby("com")}


def local_percentile(frame, column):
    """100 x share of the warm-season days of the municipality at or below the value."""
    out = np.full(len(frame), np.nan)
    codes = frame["com"].to_numpy()
    values = frame[column].to_numpy()
    for com, reference in reference_values.items():
        rows = codes == com
        out[rows] = 100 * np.searchsorted(reference, values[rows], side="right") / len(reference)
    out[np.isnan(values)] = np.nan
    return out


def natural_spline(percentile):
    """Natural cubic spline, truncated power basis, without the constant.
    Knots: the boundary knots and the internal knots of the configuration."""
    knots = np.array([TEMPERATURE["spline_boundary"][0], *TEMPERATURE["spline_knots"],
                      TEMPERATURE["spline_boundary"][1]], float) / 100
    x = np.asarray(percentile, float) / 100

    def d(k):
        return ((np.clip(x - knots[k], 0, None) ** 3 - np.clip(x - knots[-1], 0, None) ** 3)
                / (knots[-1] - knots[k]))

    return np.column_stack([x, *[d(k) - d(len(knots) - 2) for k in range(len(knots) - 2)]])


SPLINE_TERMS = [f"temp_s{i + 1}" for i in range(natural_spline([50.0]).shape[1])]
contrast_basis = natural_spline(TEMPERATURE["contrasts"]) - natural_spline([TEMPERATURE["reference"]])
```

```{python}
#| label: adjusted
referents = referent_table(deaths)
covariates = list(INCREMENTS)
lagged = with_lag([HEATWAVE, OZONE_FLAG, LOW_FLAG, variable, *[f"{v}_{METHOD}" for v in covariates]],
                  LAG_MAIN).rename(columns={HEATWAVE: "hw", OZONE_FLAG: "oz", LOW_FLAG: "above_low"})
data = referents.merge(lagged, on=["com", "date"], how="left", validate="m:1")
for v in covariates:
    data[v] = data[f"{v}_{METHOD}"] / INCREMENTS[v]
data[SPLINE_TERMS] = natural_spline(local_percentile(data, variable))
headline = add_categories(complete_strata(data, ["hw", "oz"]))
adjusted_data = complete_strata(headline, [*covariates, *SPLINE_TERMS])

adjustments = {"none": [], " + ".join(covariates): covariates, "temperature": SPLINE_TERMS,
               " + ".join([*covariates, "temperature"]): [*covariates, *SPLINE_TERMS]}
rows = []
for name, extra in adjustments.items():
    terms = [*CATEGORIES, *extra]
    beta, covariance = conditional_logit(adjusted_data[terms], adjusted_data)
    table = odds_ratio_rows(terms, beta, covariance)
    table = table[~table["term"].isin(SPLINE_TERMS)]
    if extra[-len(SPLINE_TERMS):] == SPLINE_TERMS:
        position = [terms.index(t) for t in SPLINE_TERMS]
        contrasts = [combination(w, beta[position], covariance[np.ix_(position, position)])
                     for w in contrast_basis]
        table = pd.concat([table, pd.DataFrame(contrasts, columns=["or", "or_low", "or_high"]).assign(
            term=[f"temperature_p{p}" for p in TEMPERATURE["contrasts"]])])
    rows.append(table.assign(adjustment=name))
adjusted_python = pd.concat(rows, ignore_index=True)

# Three ozone levels, reference: no heatwave and low ozone
levels = headline.copy()
levels["level"] = np.where(levels["oz"] == 1, "high", np.where(levels["above_low"] == 1, "medium", "low"))
level_terms = ["h0_medium", "h0_high", "h1_low", "h1_medium", "h1_high"]
for term in level_terms:
    heatwave_value, level = term[1], term[3:]
    levels[term] = ((levels["hw"] == int(heatwave_value)) & (levels["level"] == level)).astype(float)
beta, covariance = conditional_logit(levels[level_terms], levels)
reference_python = odds_ratio_rows(level_terms, beta, covariance)
position = [level_terms.index(t) for t in ["h1_low", "h0_high", "h1_high"]]
reference_reoi = reoi(beta[position], covariance[np.ix_(position, position)])
```

```{python}

#| label: tbl-reference
#| tbl-cap: "Three ozone levels, non-accidental mortality: Python against R."
reference_r = pd.read_csv(TABLES / "sensitivity_reference_or.csv")
reference_r = reference_r[(reference_r["outcome"] == "non_accidental") & (reference_r["lag"] == LAG_MAIN)]
compared = reference_python.merge(reference_r[["term", "or", "or_low", "or_high"]], on="term",
                                  suffixes=("_python", "_r"), validate="1:1")
assert len(compared) == len(level_terms)
compared["difference"] = relative_difference(compared[["or_python", "or_low_python", "or_high_python"]],
                                             compared[["or_r", "or_low_r", "or_high_r"]])
interaction_r = pd.read_csv(TABLES / "sensitivity_reference_interaction.csv")
interaction_r = interaction_r[(interaction_r["outcome"] == "non_accidental")
                              & (interaction_r["lag"] == LAG_MAIN) & (interaction_r["measure"] == "REOI")
                              & (interaction_r["contrast"] == "high against low ozone")]
assert len(interaction_r) == 1
reoi_difference = relative_difference([reference_reoi],
                                      interaction_r[["estimate", "low", "high"]].to_numpy())[0]
worst["three ozone levels"] = max(compared["difference"].max(), reoi_difference)
(compared[["term", "or_python", "or_low_python", "or_high_python", "or_r", "difference"]]
 .style.format({c: "{:.4f}" for c in ["or_python", "or_low_python", "or_high_python", "or_r"]}
               | {"difference": "{:.1e}"}).hide(axis="index"))
```

## All the lags in one model

```{python}
#| label: lags
data = referents.copy()
for lag in LAGS:
    lagged = with_lag([HEATWAVE, OZONE_FLAG, OZONE_SERIES, variable], lag, suffix=f"_lag{lag}")
    data = data.merge(lagged, on=["com", "date"], how="left", validate="m:1")
    data = add_categories(data, hw=f"{HEATWAVE}_lag{lag}", oz=f"{OZONE_FLAG}_lag{lag}", suffix=f"_lag{lag}")
    unknown = data[[f"{HEATWAVE}_lag{lag}", f"{OZONE_FLAG}_lag{lag}"]].isna().any(axis=1)
    data.loc[unknown, [f"{c}_lag{lag}" for c in CATEGORIES]] = np.nan
    data[f"ozone_lag{lag}"] = data[f"{OZONE_SERIES}_lag{lag}"] / OZONE_INCREMENT
    spline = natural_spline(local_percentile(data, f"{variable}_lag{lag}"))
    data[[f"temp_lag{lag}_s{i + 1}" for i in range(spline.shape[1])]] = spline

# Exposure categories
compound_terms = [f"{c}_lag{lag}" for c in CATEGORIES for lag in LAGS]
compound_data = complete_strata(data, compound_terms)
beta, covariance = conditional_logit(compound_data[compound_terms], compound_data)
by_lag = odds_ratio_rows(compound_terms, beta, covariance)
by_lag[["category", "lag"]] = by_lag["term"].str.split("_lag", expand=True)
sums = np.array([[t.startswith(c) for t in compound_terms] for c in CATEGORIES], float)
cumulative = pd.DataFrame([combination(w, beta, covariance) for w in sums],
                          columns=["or", "or_low", "or_high"]).assign(category=CATEGORIES, lag="cumulative")
compound_python = pd.concat([by_lag.drop(columns="term"), cumulative], ignore_index=True)
cumulative_reoi = reoi(sums @ beta, sums @ covariance @ sums.T)

# Temperature: one spline per lag; ozone: one linear term per lag
temperature_terms = [f"temp_lag{lag}_s{i + 1}" for lag in LAGS for i in range(len(SPLINE_TERMS))]
ozone_terms = [f"ozone_lag{lag}" for lag in LAGS]
temperature_rows, ozone_rows = [], []
for model, terms in {"temperature": temperature_terms, "ozone": ozone_terms,
                     "temperature + ozone": [*temperature_terms, *ozone_terms]}.items():
    model_data = complete_strata(data, terms)
    beta, covariance = conditional_logit(model_data[terms], model_data)
    if "temperature" in model:
        for percentile, contrast in zip(TEMPERATURE["contrasts"], contrast_basis):
            for lag in [*LAGS, "cumulative"]:
                weights = np.zeros(len(terms))
                for j in LAGS:
                    if lag in (j, "cumulative"):
                        first = terms.index(f"temp_lag{j}_s1")
                        weights[first:first + len(contrast)] = contrast
                temperature_rows.append((model, percentile, str(lag), *combination(weights, beta, covariance)))
    if "ozone" in model:
        position = [terms.index(t) for t in ozone_terms]
        for lag in [*LAGS, "cumulative"]:
            weights = np.zeros(len(terms))
            weights[[p for p, j in zip(position, LAGS) if lag in (j, "cumulative")]] = 1
            ozone_rows.append((model, str(lag), *combination(weights, beta, covariance)))
temperature_python = pd.DataFrame(temperature_rows, columns=["model", "percentile", "lag", "or", "or_low", "or_high"])
ozone_python = pd.DataFrame(ozone_rows, columns=["model", "lag", "or", "or_low", "or_high"])
```

```{python}
#| label: tbl-lags
#| tbl-cap: "Exposure categories with all the lags in one model, non-accidental mortality: Python against R."
def compare(python_table, r_file, keys):
    r_table = pd.read_csv(TABLES / r_file, dtype={"lag": str})
    r_table = r_table[r_table["outcome"] == "non_accidental"]
    merged = python_table.merge(r_table[[*keys, "or", "or_low", "or_high"]], on=keys,
                                suffixes=("_python", "_r"), validate="1:1")
    assert len(merged) == len(python_table) == len(r_table)
    merged["difference"] = relative_difference(merged[["or_python", "or_low_python", "or_high_python"]],
                                               merged[["or_r", "or_low_r", "or_high_r"]])
    return merged


def show(merged, keys):
    return (merged[[*keys, "or_python", "or_low_python", "or_high_python", "or_r", "difference"]]
            .style.format({c: "{:.4f}" for c in ["or_python", "or_low_python", "or_high_python", "or_r"]}
                          | {"difference": "{:.1e}"}).hide(axis="index"))


compound = compare(compound_python, "lags_compound_or.csv", ["category", "lag"])
interaction_r = pd.read_csv(TABLES / "lags_compound_interaction.csv")
interaction_r = interaction_r[(interaction_r["outcome"] == "non_accidental")
                              & (interaction_r["measure"] == "REOI")]
reoi_difference = relative_difference([cumulative_reoi], interaction_r[["estimate", "low", "high"]].to_numpy())[0]
worst["exposure categories, all lags"] = max(compound["difference"].max(), reoi_difference)
print(f"Cumulative REOI: Python {cumulative_reoi[0]:.4f} ({cumulative_reoi[1]:.4f} to {cumulative_reoi[2]:.4f}), "
      f"R {interaction_r['estimate'].iloc[0]:.4f}")
show(compound, ["category", "lag"])
```

```{python}
#| label: tbl-temperature
#| tbl-cap: "Temperature percentiles against the reference percentile, by lag and cumulative: one spline per lag in Python against the dlnm cross-basis in R."
temperature = compare(temperature_python, "lags_temperature_or.csv", ["model", "percentile", "lag"])
worst["temperature, all lags"] = temperature["difference"].max()
show(temperature[temperature["lag"] == "cumulative"], ["model", "percentile", "lag"])
```

```{python}
#| label: tbl-ozone
#| tbl-cap: "Ozone per increment, by lag and cumulative: Python against R."
ozone = compare(ozone_python, "lags_ozone_or.csv", ["model", "lag"])
worst["ozone, all lags"] = ozone["difference"].max()
show(ozone, ["model", "lag"])
```

## Agreement with R

```{python}
#| label: verdict
for analysis, difference in worst.items():
    print(f"{analysis:<32} largest relative difference {difference:.1e}")
tolerance = 1e-5
assert max(worst.values()) < tolerance, "Python and R disagree beyond the tolerance"
print(f"\nEvery estimate and confidence limit agrees with R within {tolerance:.0e}.")
```

The spline coefficients of the two implementations are different numbers,
because the bases differ; the odds ratios agree because the curves are the
same. The results themselves are discussed on the R pages.
